intro: A winding path through the companies, games, platforms, and tools I have helped build.

projects.name: Limit Break
projects.description: Founding engineer on Match 3 puzzle dungeon crawler.

projects.name: Bad Rabbit / Huron Portal
projects.description: Consulted on a legacy healthcare/university portal platform and a modern replacement application. Built Python scripts to extract and round-trip JavaScript from XML exports, investigated internal .NET APIs, and contributed TypeScript/React features and fixes.

projects.name: Machine Zone
projects.description: Worked on large-scale mobile strategy titles including Game of War, Mobile Strike, and Final Fantasy XV: A New Empire. Implemented client Lua/RML UI features, coordinated server-side PHP parity, and built reusable UI framework patterns for faster feature development.

projects.name: Three Rings / SEGA Networks
projects.description: Built and maintained online games and game-adjacent systems including Whirled and Puzzle Pirates. Added puzzle competitions, payment integrations, in-game purchase APIs, promotion systems, billing tools, and supported a long-running live game with substantial daily traffic.

projects.name: Perpetual Entertainment
projects.description: Worked on a shared MMO platform team building common services for friends, guilds, billing, virtual currency, telemetry, and administration. Contributed Java services, PostgreSQL-backed billing systems, audit trails, and web admin interfaces.

projects.name: Wily Technology / CA
projects.description: Built QA tooling for application performance monitoring products. Created simulation tools that generated network, database, and CPU latency so teams could test runtime instrumentation and dashboard behavior under controlled conditions.

projects.name: NightFire Software / Neustar
projects.description: Built telecom integration and order-management software for deregulated services. Worked on XML/EDI messaging, CORBA, HTTP/FTP transports, business rules engines, workflow tooling, and desktop authoring tools for complex operational processes.
